subject: expression: minimize the `PushDownContext` (#52135)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The change shrinks `expression.PushDownContext` to avoid carrying full `SessionVars`, replacing it with (a) a warning handler adapter for pushdown warnings and (b) a cached `group_concat_max_len` value. `sessionctx/variable` adds `SessionVars.GroupConcatMaxLen` plus sysvar `SetSession`/`GetSession` wiring so the cached value tracks session sysvar changes; planner call sites switch to `NewPushDownContextFromSessionVars`. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, session behavior, or pushdown/runtime handling for the touched areas.
